definitions.explanation: A feeling of admiration and deference toward someone.

examples.japanese: {敬意|けいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
{敬意|けいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{敬意|けいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I have deep respect for my teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{敬意|けいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|ひょう}したい→表す：01868_arawasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。

examples.english: I think that interacting with respect for the other party's culture and customs is the foundation of international exchange.

notes:
{敬意|けいい} is a formal noun referring to a feeling of respect and admiration toward someone. Unlike ⟦{尊敬|そんけい}→尊敬：01454_sonkei⟧, which is also used as a verb (⟦{尊敬|そんけい}する→尊敬：01454_sonkei⟧), {敬意|けいい} is primarily used in set phrases and written language.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {敬意|けいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to express respect
- {敬意|けいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay respect
- {敬意|けいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have respect
- {敬意|けいい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧: with respect, respectfully
- {敬意|けいい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{値|あたい}する→値する：25545_ataisuru⟧: to be worthy of respect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{尊敬|そんけい}→尊敬：01454_sonkei⟧: respect (general, also a suru verb)
- ⟦{尊重|そんちょう}→尊重：03327_sonchou⟧: respect for opinions, rights, or values
- ⟦{畏敬|いけい}→畏敬：10033_ikei⟧: awe, reverence (stronger than {敬意|けいい})

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in speeches, official correspondence, and written Japanese. In casual speech, ⟦{尊敬|そんけい}→尊敬：01454_sonkei⟧ or ⟦リスペクト→リスペクト：11222_risupekuto⟧ is more natural.
